highlights: Developed and maintained a role-based CRM platform using React and TypeScript, implementing core modules including Orders, Sales Pipeline, Inventory, Depots, Users, Tickets, and Notifications.
Architected and migrated the frontend to a scalable Turborepo monorepo, creating reusable shared packages for API clients, components, providers, utilities, and types across multiple applications.
Designed and implemented a granular permission-based access control system supporting role-specific access to menus, sections, tabs, columns, filters, tables, and actions.

Built complex sales and operational workflows including Commissions, Discounts, Sales Tax, Refunds, Contracts, Order Notes, Announcements, and Analytics, integrating them with backend APIs and real-time updates.
Established frontend testing practices using Vitest, React Testing Library, and MSW, while applying Clean Code, SOLID, DRY, and Design Patterns to maintain a scalable and maintainable codebase.

Developed an appointment scheduling system for public hospitals and private clinics using Next.js, enabling patients to book appointments and verify their information through integrations with government medical organizations such as Social Security Insurance and Health Insurance — cutting average appointment booking time significantly.

Built a real-time support chat system using React and WebSocket, enabling seamless communication between patients and support representatives and measurably improving response times and customer satisfaction.
Engineered a doctor profile platform using Next.js, showcasing doctors' backgrounds, experience, and professional history, which contributed to higher patient engagement with doctor profiles.
Created a React-based dashboard for doctors to manage and prescribe medications, streamlining the prescription workflow and reducing time spent on administrative tasks.

Led and organized the front-end development team, driving the adoption of modern technologies and migrating two legacy websites to React-based Single-Page Applications (SPAs), improving page load speed and user retention.
Mentored junior developers, conducted in-depth code reviews to ensure high code quality, and led the development of two scalable React-based dashboards serving over 2,000 active users.
Delivered 10 fully functional MVPs within 12 months using Next.js and Supabase's serverless architecture, consistently meeting tight deadlines while maintaining high-quality standards.

Designed and developed an e-commerce platform using Next.js, implementing advanced rendering strategies (SSR & SSG) to optimize performance and SEO, reducing page load time and increasing organic traffic.
Launched a React-based admin panel for uploading and managing 3D models for AR web experiences, including comprehensive product management features.
